widgets.title: First launches per day, by platform
widgets.query: index=dino_usage platform!=sonos platform!=alexa installAge=first name=app_opened | timechart span=1d count by platform

widgets.title: Seconds listened per day
widgets.query: index=dino_usage platform!=sonos platform!=alexa name IN ("read_paused","read_stopped") seconds>=0 | timechart span=1d sum(seconds)

widgets.title: First-launch funnel (sessions), by platform and version
widgets.query: index=dino_usage platform!=sonos platform!=alexa installAge=first | stats count(eval(name="app_opened")) as opened, count(eval(name="intro_ended")) as onboarded, count(eval(name="book_opened")) as book_opened, count(eval(name="read_started")) as read_started, count(eval(name="book_listened")) as listened_30s by session, platform, version | stats count as sessions, count(eval(onboarded>0)) as onboarded, count(eval(book_opened>0)) as book_opened, count(eval(read_started>0)) as read_started, count(eval(listened_30s>0)) as listened_30s by platform, version

widgets.title: Where first sessions stopped (last screen and event)
widgets.query: index=dino_usage platform!=sonos platform!=alexa installAge=first | sort session, sinceLaunch, seq | stats last(screen) as last_screen, last(name) as last_event by session | stats count by last_screen, last_event | sort -count
